assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square seamless game material diffuse/albedo texture
Primary request: create a realistic macro botanical texture of green broadleaf epidermal tissue, suitable for mango, guava, and rainforest foliage materials.
Composition: perfectly flat, tile filled edge to edge, with understated branching leaf veins and natural fine surface texture. The pattern should be seamless or nearly seamless at all four edges, with no focal point.
Lighting: neutral, uniform flat/albedo lighting with no directional highlight, no cast shadow, no lighting gradient, no perspective.
Color palette: varied but restrained natural greens.
Constraints: texture only; macro tissue surface fills the entire square.
Avoid: whole leaf silhouette, leaf edge, background, drop shadow, branch, stem, central midrib, text, labels, watermark, 3D render.
assets.inspection: Square, edge-filled green macro tissue with branching veins and fine surface detail. No silhouette, background, drop shadow, or obvious perspective. Veins read clearly and are somewhat stronger than understated, but remain usable for broadleaf albedo.
